title: Retrospective Evaluation of Visual Outcomes, Safety and Enhancement Rates Following Wavefront-Guided LASIK Using a 10 MHz Elita Femtosecond Laser
official: Retrospective Evaluation of Visual Outcomes, Safety and Enhancement Rates Following Wavefront-Guided LASIK Using a 10 MHz Elita Femtosecond Laser
summary: The goal of this retrospective chart review is to evaluate the effectiveness of a 10MHz femtosecond laser utilized in performing wavefront-guided LASIK in a myopic population. Our hypothesis is that the outcomes will be as good as if not better than previous myopic LASIK outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Consecutive eyes with myopia or myopic astigmatism Underwent wavefront-guided LASIK At least 6-12 months of follow up

\-

Exclusion Criteria:

Uncontrolled systemic or ocular disease, No prior ocular trauma or surgery, Visual acuity less than 20/20 Ocular pathology affecting visual acuity Abnormal pupils Inability to obtain wavefront measurements Contact lens wear within 7 days prior to surgery
